note: With a verb: to like doing: *Ich schwimme gern.* = I like swimming. *Gern!* = With pleasure!
The comparative of *gern*: *Ich trinke lieber Tee.* = I prefer tea.
*Am liebsten esse ich Pizza.* = I like pizza best.
Paying: *Zusammen oder getrennt?* = Together or separately?
*genauso gut wie* = just as good as.
*Das musst du unbedingt sehen!* = You absolutely have to see that!
*Danke sehr!* Too is *zu*: *Das ist zu teuer.*
Also *whole*: *der ganze Tag*. *ganz gut* = quite good.
*Ich warte schon lange.* = I've been waiting a long time.
*erst morgen* = not until tomorrow; *erst um acht* = only at eight.
*Was machst du eigentlich?* = What do you actually do?
